notes.title: “Battle” is here!
notes.content:
The second edition of Humankind: The Awakening brings 250 new cards that will add all kinds of new challenges to our gameplay.

We’re also adding monthly prizes for all the players who join our leagues. Deck size has been modified to 61 cards now. Are you ready for the challenge?

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.15
notes.content:
This version includes many improvements and fixes:

- From now, the daily reward will award "Battle" booster packs, which is the next expansion of HumanKind
- Added new explanation for many Character Gifts inside of the card text
- Now you can claim your daily reward just by playing 3 matches or wining just 1
- From now you have to play 3 turns in order to cocede a game
- Many improvements to friend list, and now is faster to challenge friends
- Many other text fixes

notes.title: Spooky News!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Friends!

On this patch we bring very special changes to the game prepared by all the HK team, based on the feedback we received from you.

[h1]New game UI[/h1]
We have prepared an all-new User Interface. Cleaner, faster and completely animated. Now it's easier to find any part of the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30298895/6e3b4e2b6afb935b3125687967e3c089f909659d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Deck editor and collection[/h1]
We heard you! Now the deck editor and collection viewer are the same screen and it's a lot easier to use!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30298895/a591c6fdbb4292bfa64bf1a29db49ca2e5a4396e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Halloween Event[/h1]
From now and until October 3rd, just for connecting to the game you'll receive an exclusive avatar and a free Halloween special Promo Card!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30298895/4d4e7aa47239bf4816754bd2f902ee6680fedc18.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30298895/2de330a9e8f0eac2416227605b959367d240c21d.jpg[/img]

See you in the game!

notes.title: Welcome to HumanKind the Awakening!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! We are happy to launch the game today!

Thanks to all of you who waited for it, now is ready to play on Steam.

We hope you enjoy playing this game as much as we enjoy developing it!

-The Dark Polygon Team.
